method_notes: LB Redbridge Admission Arrangements for Community Primary and Secondary Schools 2027-28 (paras 1.9, 3.3 and Note 3) use shortest (safe) walking distance, measured by a Geographic Information System from the child's home to the main entrance of the school along public roads and recognised footpaths. For flats in the same block the distance is measured from the block's main entrance. Recognised routes must be paved or tarmac, lit, well maintained and accessible at all times, so informal paths and paths across private land may be excluded; routes are fixed before the admissions round. Equal distances are settled by random allocation in the Synergy admissions system. Sibling priority lapses if the family has moved more than one mile from the school since the sibling's offer (offer-day sheets). Community primaries have no catchment areas, so the order is LAC, staff children, siblings, then distance. Seven Kings (all-through community school) and Loxford (all-through academy) give catchment priority. Faith and own-admission-authority schools (Al-Noor, Atam, Avanti Court, OLOL, Wanstead Church, the Catholic and Jewish schools) use faith banding or criteria; the council sheet reports their last band.

gaps: The 2025 sheet prints an on-time 'distance offered' for nearly every school, including schools that clearly had spare places: their late applicants were also offered (e.g. Barley Lane 9.870, Redbridge Primary 5.911, Parkhill 9.145 miles). Where late applications were offered, the year is recorded as all_offered, with the printed figure in criterion_note. This is an inference. Where 2025 late applications got 'None Offered', the printed distance is kept. Some kept 2025 and 2026 distances are large (Oakdale Infants 9.408 and 5.044, Gilbert Colvin 5.290, Manford 3.694 miles) and may mean the school was barely oversubscribed; they are recorded as printed. For faith and banded schools (Al-Noor, Atam, Avanti Court, OLOL, Wanstead Church, Seven Kings, Loxford) the value recorded is the last band or criterion listed, with the other bands in criterion_note; Avanti Court 2026 offered no places to Band 4 (non-faith). Wanstead Church 2025 printed no units (assumed miles). The 2024 sheet is an image-only PDF, transcribed by eye from the Internet Archive copy. PAN is the 2027-28 determined admission number and is given only for community schools (Redbridge Primary drops from 120 to 90 in 2027). Academy, free and VA PANs are left null. The faith and academy admission policies were not read individually. The 2027-28 arrangements document does not set out primary criteria in full; walking measurement taken from its general paragraphs. Junior schools (Churchfields, Oakdale and Parkhill Juniors) are excluded.
